claim_scope: For each admissible binary index 0,3,6,10 and every extension degree, exact fixed-point and unoriented primitive-two-cycle counts for the map on the absolute trace-one fiber.
integrity: The factorization is checked by a package-contained exact binary polynomial checker; the proof of all degrees is the algebraic trace argument. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: No periods longer than two; no transfer to arbitrary linearized composites. Related 2025 full text inaccessible, so unindexed/implicit earlier coverage remains a residual risk. Finite checker is not an infinite proof.
title: Exact short-cycle census for the four binary Kloosterman permutations
